correctness.rationale: Trace annihilator and single-Jordan-block projectors prove the necessary and sufficient condition for every characteristic-p field. Rational canonical class/centralizer formulas, the q-binomial identity and the monic-polynomial Euler product prove the exact all-size enumerator. Orbit and affine-fiber dimensions prove the first modular dimension jump. The included code independently checks six small parameter settings including a nonprime field; no finite extrapolation is invoked.

value.rationale: The Jordan plane is a natural classical noncommutative algebra with previously established characteristic-zero representation geometry. A full nonsemisimple primary-type solvability test and complete all-size labeled finite-field point counts resolve natural classification/enumeration questions and identify a sharp characteristic-dependent selection of Euler factors. The dimension boundary n=p is a structural change, not an arbitrary slice.
